apply.description: Create a child checkpoint from a recipe (pass plan's result.recipe) or a program. Needs a key: reuse the same key to retry after a lost or timed-out answer and you get the same child with no second charge. Costs one apply from the quota. May answer 202 with a proposal_id when a person must approve. Next: diff with result.diff_hint.

changes.description: Legacy v0.1: per-sample prediction changes of a run (paged).

compare.description: Legacy v0.1: baseline-versus-intervention comparison of a finished run.

describe.description: The tensor table of a checkpoint: name, dtype, shape, editable; with a graph attached also the role of each axis and the groups each tensor belongs to. Start here; filter with name_glob ('*.weight', 'layer3.*'). Free (metadata). Next: groups for coupled units, stats or query for numbers.

diff.description: Compare checkpoint_id with other: bitwise per tensor, with changed counts and max_abs; with a selector, one selection in detail. Use it after apply to check the child against its parent (copy apply's diff_hint). Costs scan. values: true returns element deltas and needs weights:values.

get_checkpoint.description: One checkpoint's metadata plus lineage: parent_id, recipe_hash and children (ids). Use it to walk from a child back to its parent or to list what was made from a base. Free.

graph.description: The attached model graph (structure only): nodes with op, module path and the rule applied, or the module tree (view: 'modules'). Without a graph it returns the attach card; only a person can attach one. Free. Next: groups or graph_node.

graph_node.description: One graph node: its op, arguments, the tensors it consumes, the rule that applied or why it is opaque, and the groups it touches. Use it to understand why a group is open. Free.

groups.description: Coupling groups: units that must move together across tensors (a conv's out channels with its BN and the next conv's in channels). closed=true groups can be permuted with permute_units; open ones list a boundary reason. Filter by tensor, node, module_prefix, kind. Free. Next: stats or query with selector {group, units}, or plan.

list_checkpoints.description: Checkpoints in this workspace (id, display name, parent_id, recipe_hash, sizes). Use it to find the base to work on. Free. Next: describe(checkpoint_id) for its tensors.

plan.description: Dry run of an edit: program [{op, args, select}] plus hypothesis, or a recipe. Returns the frozen recipe, per-op effects and warnings; writes nothing. Ops: zero, scale{k}, set/add{value|blob}, clamp{min,max}, lerp{source,t}, copy_from{source}, permute_units{perm} on a closed group. Costs scan. Next: apply with recipe=result.recipe.

examples.hypothesis: Zeroing these units removes the false positive

propose.description: Legacy v0.1 (MNIST fixture only): record an intervention as a recipe for a run.

query.description: Find tensors by name_glob, dtype, ndim, size or editable; with where {stat, axis, op, value} rank units by a statistic (for example l2 per output channel lt 0.01). With where.group it ranks a group's units. Costs scan when where is given. Next: pass matches[0].selector straight to plan as a program select.

read_tensor.description: Raw element values of a selection, paged by max_elems with a cursor. Needs weights:values (egress class 2): the values leave the machine with your answer. Prefer stats or query for decisions. Costs values (elements returned) and scan.

run.description: Legacy v0.1 (MNIST fixture only): submit an evaluation run of a recipe; needs a key.

session_info.description: Your session: capabilities, egress class, apply quota and budgets (values, scan, applies, blob_bytes: limit, used, remaining). Call it first, and again before a costly step. Free. If a capability you need is missing, stop and report it; do not look for another path.

stats.description: Statistics of a selection (count, mean, std, l1, l2, min, max, zero_frac), as one summary or per unit (reduce_over_axes: the axes to summarise over; leave the unit axis out). Selector: tensor-local {tensor, index} or a group {group, units}. Costs scan (elements read). In egress class 1 each unit needs at least K elements.

status.description: Legacy v0.1: status of a run.

trace.description: Your session's event timeline (ids only): each call, its status and charges, and for each apply the plans and reads that led to it. Use it to write the hand-off report. Free.

upload_blob.description: Upload a flat little-endian float32 array (base64, at most 1 MiB per call) for set or add ops that need one value per element; returns a blob id to use as args.blob. Costs blob_bytes. Prefer a scalar value when one number is enough.

validate.description: The same checks as plan, reported as {valid, checks, error} instead of an error. Use it to test a program before planning. Costs scan. Writes nothing.
